reserveReview.rationale: Fresh pinned reads at Berachain block 28038152 (hash 0x68659a2c65b5affec7c9e4ae08cb378adbb852c82cfc3587050d41283f729300, timestamp 2026-10-27T08:50:20Z): for each of the thirteen configured collateral vaults the holder's share balance was read, converted to underlying assets through totalAssets() and totalSupply(), and valued at the DefiLlama berachain quote of the vault's asset() observed at the same time. DefiLlama had no quote for the pumpBTC and beraETH underlying assets, so those two used the same-block branch fetchPrice() oracle. All thirteen balances are positive. Resulting values were approximately $6,935.90 WETH, $7,088.97 WETH-WBTC Kodiak Island, $1,477.03 WETH-HONEY Kodiak Island, $1,109.68 beraETH, $1,242.06 solvBTC, $938.08 solvBTC.bbn, $781.79 pumpBTC, $684.55 WBTC-HONEY Kodiak Island, $321.18 uniBTC, $249.81 ylstETH, $217.06 rsETH, $97.97 Stakestone ETH, and $60.35 WBERA, totaling about $21,204 and normalized to the stated weights at one decimal. The Kodiak Island branch oracle prices exceed the DefiLlama quotes by roughly 13% to 32%, so island weights are quote-dependent. At Berachain block 27028385 (hash 0xc1e8698e0dd085d316fdd73b6ee1b7e8af57f9dea43fd30ef6b990e623d3c738), the exact ylstETH collateral vault asset() is 0xa958090601e21a82e9873042652e35891d945a8c; its name() is CIAN yield layer stETH and symbol() is ylstETH. CIAN's primary documentation identifies ylstETH as its stETH Yield Layer receipt, correcting the former YieldNest obligor attribution. The documented roughly five-day estimate is not a complete Berachain whole-position realization bound, so liquidity remains unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: All thirteen configured Beraborrow collateral-vault balances read on Berachain block 28038152 on 2026-10-27, converted through each ERC-4626 vault's totalAssets and totalSupply and valued at contemporaneous DefiLlama quotes of the underlying assets
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All configured positive branches are identified and weighted. Wrapper custody, validator, LP unwind, oracle, and liquidation-liquidity risks remain explicit structured risk factors rather than unclassified exposure.
